experiment_data.hypothesis: N-scaling convergence test: CoNLL N=64 (8× N=8) finetuned model. CoNLL has highest degeneracy (~60% at N=8). Tests whether degeneracy continues declining and whether the marginal MV Δ improvement from N=16→32→64 is negligible. Fourth data point for N-scaling convergence curve. Part of extended N-scaling suite for R34 C1.
